title: Sparse relation token-geometry shape corrective V1
purpose: Correct and requalify the sparse relation candidate after detecting one unused sixth uncertainty channel for a five-dimensional width-plus-profile target.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training corrective using the same eight fixed C01-C03 observations; verify the exact 65-parameter removal and full real core-plus-descriptor backward without reading validation or test shards.
approval.confirmation_reference: User authorized autonomous evidence-optimal corrections and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Same eight fixed five-frame C01-C03 observations used by prior readiness runs.
Sealed cardinality corrective and predecessor checkpoints for provenance only.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Exactly eight fixed fit observations and 34 unique causal frames.

sampling.rule: No selection change; reuse the immutable readiness rows.

teacher.source: Objective event, branch presence/identity, opening width, four-value vertical profile, axis and global geometry.
teacher.valid_mask: Token uncertainty dimension must be exactly one width plus four profile values. Missing early frames remain masked.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Teacher identity is loss-only; forward remains scans-only and emits no graph state.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only fit rows execute; no validation/test output or threshold is read.

methods.main: Change token geometry head output from 11 to 10 values so four profile residuals have exactly five uncertainty scales with width. Re-run count/causal invariants and full core-plus-descriptor finite backward.
methods.baseline: The sealed 784578-parameter cardinality candidate whose sixth uncertainty value had no matching target.
methods.fallback: Any shape, gradient or invariant failure stops training; no channel padding, silent slicing, data change or graph compensation.

failure_policy: No optimizer, checkpoint, C07-C10 shard, M-TARE, graph or planner. Any source drift, missing gradient, shape or invariant failure stops.
retention: Retain exact shape/parameter report, losses/gradients, invariants, figures/source, CSV, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One deterministic CUDA full forward/backward on eight fit observations
